#2026世界市长对话宁波#
【从宁波出发：航线通达全球700多个港口】被誉为“古丝绸之路活化石”的宁波拥有独特的地理优势，是重要的交通枢纽。宁波舟山港联通全球主要航区，背靠广袤腹地，是古代海上丝绸之路的重要始发港。如今的宁波舟山港已开辟300多条集装箱航线，辐射全球200多个国家和地区的700多个港口，连续17年位居世界货物吞吐量第一。As a major maritime hub in east China's Zhejiang Province, Ningbo has long been a crossroads of culture and commerce. Known as a "living fossil" of the ancient Silk Road, the city remains a symbol of China's enduring maritime ambitions.
Once an important starting point of the ancient Maritime Silk Road, Ningbo-Zhoushan Port now operates more than 300 container shipping routes, connecting with over 700 ports in more than 200 countries and regions and linking global markets with China's vast hinterland.
Ranked first in the world in cargo throughput for 17 consecutive years, the port offers a glimpse into China's role in global maritime trade. Its extensive network also reflects the development of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road and the broader blue economy.
